objective: Evaluate the operational old neutral framing versus the new production-failure/loss framing on one known Stop 2 behavior before and after its verified repair. No production changes.
design: Four independent, sequential Mercury runs; one question per dispatch. Same source, tools, current harness, model settings and token setting within each source pair. Both user question framing and its corresponding system-prompt addition change together: this tests the deployed prompt package, not attribution to either text alone. Balanced order; no reviewers receive prior answers or expected outcomes.
sourceComparison: Each source ref is compared to itself so no repair diff or expected result is supplied. Explicit CandleProcessor target with tools free to follow producers/consumers. Canonical exclusions stay enforced.
grading: Does the answer identify the demonstrated completion/interval failure on the pre-repair source with a reachable mechanism and correct source evidence?
Does it describe repaired completion honestly without alleging a defect contradicted by executable evidence?
Does any additional claim establish producer, consumer, trigger and consequence; otherwise is it named as unverified?
Does it distinguish possible trading harm from demonstrated monetary loss?
Record complete answers, tools, latency, tokens, provider-estimated cost, run completeness and warnings.

before.boundaryOnly: A response containing only the already-known right boundary removes the job and emits completed while only two boundary bars remain.
before.delayedRetry: Kraken since moves forward with now; a 31-minute delayed retry misses the original three missing bars.

after.boundaryOnly: Missing requested left anchor leaves job pending with range_start_unavailable.
after.delayedRetry: Fixed original range restores the three real interior bars and completes with coverage.
after.sparse: Confirmed sparse interval may complete with zero interior bars; do not invent one bar per clock slot.

limitations: One run per prompt/source cell: directional pilot, not statistical proof or guarantee.
Historical repository context is visible through tools; this is not a blinded benchmark.
Model/provider variability and caching may affect cost/time. Costs are ledger estimates, not invoices.
Only Mercury is selected. This is a prompt experiment, not fresh panel approval or live trading acceptance.
